en.title: Gum disease: losing the bone around your teeth

sentences.text: This is a healthy lower jaw.
The bone comes up close to the necks of the teeth.
Gum disease (periodontitis) slowly wears away the gum and bone that hold your teeth.
sentences.tts: Gum disease, periodontitis, slowly wears away the gum and bone that hold your teeth.

sentences.text: Red shows the bone that has gone.
Dentists use stages one to four. Stage one is the mildest.
By stage four, much of the bone has gone.
Teeth can become loose, move or need to come out.
Lost bone mostly does not grow back, but you and your dentist can control the disease.
See a dentist if your gums keep bleeding.
